Bachelor programme in physics M.Sc. programme in physics M.Sc. programme in climate change Bachelor programme in nanoscience M.Sc. programme in nanoscience M.Sc. in Quantum Information Science Study at the Niels Bohr Institute At the Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen we offer B.Sc. and M.Sc. programmes in physics, nanoscience and climate change. You can also follow courses as an exchange student, credit student etc., and we have a PhD programme for researchers. PhD The Niels Bohr Institute trains researchers through the PhD programme. Read more at the home page of the PhD School Open positions at the Niels Bohr Institute >> Exchange studies You can take e.g. one or two semesters at the Niels Bohr Institute as part of your M.Sc. or B.Sc. education. Read more about exchange studies Credit student A credit student is a full degree student or PhD student at one of the other faculties at UCPH or at another Danish education institution. Attending a course as a credit student is free of charge. Read more about how to become credit student Continuing education You can update or upgrade your qualifications by taking BSc or MSc courses as single subjects or take a master programme. You can also customize courses. Single subjects Master's Programmes and Courses Customized courses Guest student You can become a guest student if you are currently enrolled as a full degree student at a non-partner university abroad or you are an exchange student at another Danish university. As a guest student, you normally enroll for one or two semesters. Read more about studying as a guest student Students Are you a student at one of the Niels Bohr Institute educations in physics, nanoscience or climate change? At the institute pages in KUnet, you can find information specific to the Niels Bohr Institute, e.g.: Guideline for projects outside the course scope The educational affairs team Student instructor program NBI Handbook in KUnet about teaching As a student you can get much more information about your education in the faculty pages in KUnet, such as: Projects Study abroad Rules and deadlines Course registration Exams Forms Block structure, time tables etc. Direct link to your education: B.Sc. student, physics (in Danish) M.Sc. student, physics B.Sc. student, nanoscience (in Danish) M.Sc. student, nanoscience M.Sc. student, climate change (CCIMA) Application procedure Admission requirements Exchange programmes International students NBI på Facebook Content not available due to cookie preferences You cannot see the content of this field because of your cookie preferences.
